tools.name: appraise_vehicle
tools.description: A derived TradeBasis asking-price market average. Supply odometerMiles plus either vin or all of year, make, model and trim. Ask the user for missing details; never invent vehicle identity or mileage. VIN-assisted decoding may still require a confirmed trim, fuelType or bodyStyle. If supplied identity conflicts with the VIN, ask the user to verify the VIN and conflicting fields; do not choose silently or retry unchanged. Omit market for nationwide US. Not a trade-in offer or completed-sale value.

vin.description: VIN-assisted input: provide the vehicle's 17-character VIN with odometerMiles. Optional for complete manual input. Decoding may leave trim, fuelType or bodyStyle unresolved; ask the user to confirm them, never guess. If decoding fails, confirm the VIN or omit vin and use complete manual input. Supplied identity must agree with the VIN.

year.description: Confirmed model year. Required without vin; optional with vin, but must agree with the decoded year. Ask the user if unknown.

make.description: Confirmed vehicle manufacturer. Required without vin; optional with vin, but must agree with the decoded make.

model.description: Confirmed US model name. Required without vin; optional with vin, but must agree with the decoded model.

trim.description: Confirmed exact trim, including meaningful +, hyphens and powertrain qualifiers. Required without vin. With vin, supply it if decoding does not identify one unambiguous trim; never assume Base or choose from a decoded list.

odometerMiles.description: Current odometer reading in miles, required for BOTH input paths. Ask the user; never estimate mileage from the VIN or model year. Zero is valid only when actually reported.

market.description: Optional US state name or two-letter state code, not the user's precise location. Omit for nationwide US.

fuelType.description: Optional confirmed powertrain/fuel type. Required later if identity is ambiguous. Ask the user rather than selecting a default; must agree with a reported VIN powertrain.

bodyStyle.description: Optional confirmed body style: sedan, hatchback, coupe, convertible, SUV, pickup, wagon, minivan or van. Required later if identity is ambiguous; ask the user and do not contradict the VIN.
